invariants.rationale: The method is expected to always return a non-null List since it invokes postWrite and returns its result.
The method assumes preppedRecords is valid for delete, so it is likely never null at method exit.
An empty or null instantTime would be invalid for write operations, so this invariant likely holds.
If no records are given for deletion, the result should be empty.
Each prepped record can lead to at most one WriteStatus; the returned list of status objects should not exceed input.
